subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a core N-turn model lease such as `/model <ref> --turns N` with per-model max-turn config, or should temporary model routing be limited to a narrower one-turn/image/fallback design?
rationale: This changes slash-command syntax, config schema, session state, provider/auth routing, warnings, and auto-revert behavior, which AGENTS.md treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface rather than a safe autonomous bug fix.

options.title: Keep open for model-routing design
options.body: Use this issue to decide the durable temporary-model contract after comparing the one-turn override and image-revert proposals.

options.title: Narrow to one-turn override first
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 as the first implementation step and revisit multi-turn leases only after the one-turn API lands.

options.title: Reject core turn leases
options.body: Keep persistent `/model` plus explicit `/model default` and document cost-governance patterns outside core instead of adding counters and revert state.

recommendation.title: Keep open for model-routing design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to decide the durable temporary-model contract after comparing the one-turn override and image-revert proposals.

likelyOwner.reason: The current model/session override implementation and docs blame to @vincentkoc's recent merged refactor, making him the best available routing owner from repository history.
